programme.desc: The headlines from ABC News, updating you on the day's top stories from across Australia and around the world.

programme.title: QI
programme.desc: Another instalment of 'I' related information including income tax, inflation and imperial Rome. Joining QI master Stephen Fry are Alan Davies, Al Murray, Sandi Toksvig and Dara O'Briain.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: A magical man turns Finn into a foot. They meet others who have been similarly wronged and must work together.

programme.title: We Baby Bears
programme.desc: The Bears and their new friend, Squatter Otter, take up residence in a mysterious house made of meat.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: When Robin Booty Scootys his butt off, the Titans must go on an adventure to recover the lost booty.

programme.title: The Powerpuff Girls
programme.desc: The holidays are Mojo's favourite time for ruining everything! But this year, he may just learn the reason for the season.

programme.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
programme.desc: Legendary Parisian ice-cream maker Andre gets akumatized by Hawk Moth. Now Glaciator, he turns people into ice cream, which starts to melt! Ladybug and Cat Noir cannot get cold feet if they want to stop him!

programme.title: Malory Towers
programme.desc: The pressure is on for the second-form to win a local football tournament and buy George the Donkey his freedom. before the abattoir take him away!

programme.title: Odd Squad
programme.desc: A motley crew of villains storm into Odd Squad headquarters, but can't agree on a plan of attack.

programme.title: We Bare Bears
programme.desc: The Baby Bears sign up for a game of laser tag.

programme.title: Little Lunch
programme.desc: Tamara is very good on the monkey bars since she uses them every day, but Melanie not so good as Tamara never lets her on them. When Melanie demands a proper turn, Tamara is outraged and so a battle of wills begins.

programme.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
programme.desc: As May sets out to catch a Wurmple for her first Pokemon Contest, Ash receives a Double Battle challenge!

programme.title: Transformers: Earthspark
programme.desc: Bumblebee's past as an elite racecar driver is exposed and Special Agent Schloder is hot on his trail.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Finn goes on a quest to prove Flame Princess isn't really evil.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Raven just wants some peace and quiet for once. but accidentally makes a deal that eliminates all sounds.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin decides to split each Titan with a prism.

programme.title: Gumball: The Best of Carrie
programme.desc: Gumball catches Darwin gazing at a photo of Teri on Elmore Plus and enlists Carrie to help bring them together. When they can't make Darwin and Teri's love blossom naturally, they decide to make it happen supernaturally.

programme.title: Unikitty
programme.desc: Following the events of Master Frown's birthday, Unikitty and her friends form a resistance group to restore the Unikingdom.

programme.title: Submarine Jim
programme.desc: After discovering that Shamik doesn't like him, Jim pretends to be an intern in order to befriend him. But the only way to achieve his goal is to speak ill of himself.

programme.title: Total Dramarama
programme.desc: Gwen tries to convince Chef to tell the class the truth about their pet goldfish.

programme.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
programme.desc: Because of a plan thought up by Marinette, Shadow Moth akumatizes two villains. Ladybug and Cat Noir will need help to stop the evil duo!

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Using a HAT and a MUG, Alphablocks H and M build sandcastles. H's has a TOP; M's grows UP. The PEN helps M decorate; H uses a DOT. I tries to say who will WIN, and is surprised!

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: The Colourblocks meet a new animal - but what colour is it? Learn about a creature than can change colour with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: One, Two, Threebies!
programme.desc: Tri and Roh are racing to get concert tickets, but Boxy is rolling themselves as a dice to decide how many steps they will take.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Five must work with her friends to reach the stars and make a wish.

programme.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures
programme.desc: Mr. More adds syllables to the word banana' and makes a never-ending ba-na-na-na-na-na-na-na! When Alpha Pig shows Wonder Red his new Shrink Ray, it accidentally shrinks THEM! Mr. More turns harmless flowers into enormous monster plants!

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?

programme.title: Water Rats - S7 E16 - The Marrying Kind
programme.desc: A discovery of a wetsuit leads to a investigation of a woman who went missing two and a half years ago and everything points to the involvement of her husband.

programme.title: Water Rats - S7 E17 - Bitter Legacy
programme.desc: When the Nemesis responds to a report of gunshots being fired, Sykes and Quinn come across two teenage boys who have been injured, one fatally, after the gun they were playing with exploded.

programme.title: Highway Patrol
programme.desc: Officers spot a car going at warp speed and when the driver shows no sign of stopping, it becomes a full-blown pursuit. Police are baffled when they pull over a driver who insists he is a UFO. A driver goes ballistic when he's caught driving his unregistered car.

programme.title: Motorbike Cops
programme.desc: A guy claims he was speeding to save his life so he wouldn't be car-jacked but Kelly isn't convinced. Mark and Rohan are sick of busting driver after driver on their mobile phones with lame excuses.

programme.title: Highway Patrol
programme.desc: A massive roadside stoush unfolds when officers stop a man who hasn't installed his interlock device. A dodgy looking car leads officers on a pursuit at high speed through the streets of Yarra.

programme.title: Alastair Clarkson, Pt. 1
programme.desc: Hamish McLachlan sits down with some of the AFL's most prominent personalities for in depth conversations revealing, challenges, triumphs, and vulnerabilities, beyond their sporting achievements.

programme.title: Rnd 4: Brisbane v Collingwood
programme.desc: The Lions clash with the Magpies, live and free from the Gabba. Bounce time: 7:30 pm AEDT.

programme.title: Melbourne v Gold Coast SUNS | Round 4
programme.desc: Gold Coast head to the MCG for their last appearance of the home-and-away season to take on Melbourne, who look to continue their perfect start at home in 2026

programme.title: Winners & Losers S1 Ep12
programme.desc: As a power failure hits the inner-city, two relationships bloom and two unravel. But the girls barely have time to process these new developments when tragedy strikes.

programme.title: Winners & Losers S1 Ep13
programme.desc: The girls' worlds are turned upside town when Bec and Doug are involved in a serious car accident.

programme.title: Winners & Losers S1 Ep14
programme.desc: Sophie decides she needs to break it off with JB, Matt has second thoughts about his feelings, and Jenny decides to reboot her life with new friends and a new man.

programme.title: Duct Tape Special
programme.desc: The Mythbusters once again join forces with their favourite mechanical cure all and use Duct Tape to build a trebuchet and save Buster’s life.

programme.title: Cooking Chaos
programme.desc: The guys take on two more food fables by testing a pair of viral video sensations, cannon fired shrimp and an explosive smoothie.

programme.title: Explosion Special
programme.desc: In this explosion special Adam and Jamie have a blast testing two spectacular tall tales.

programme.title: Code 1: Minute By Minute
programme.desc: On 15 December 2014 eighteen people were taken hostage in Sydney’s Lindt café. Eyewitnesses and first responders explain what happened minute by minute in the months and weeks leading up to the horror.

programme.title: Medical Emergency
programme.desc: After fifty years on the job, a carpenter's just made his first big mistake. A stoush in the playground has put a ten year-old boy in hospital, and a young woman has driven into the back of a truck.

programme.title: Surf Patrol
programme.desc: A huge storm rolls into Surfers Paradise and the swell causes major problems for lifesavers. Then, a swimmer is dumped near the shoreline and cracks his neck.

programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - Up In Smoke
programme.desc: A romantic evening ends abruptly when a dead body is found in the chimney of an aging bachelor’s house. Sara, Nick and Brass are called in to investigate.

programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - I Like To Watch
programme.desc: A young woman is found drugged and sexually assaulted in the hallway of her high-rise apartment building. The CSIs try to nail the psychotic criminal who appears to have a passion for pedicures.

programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - The Unusual Suspect
programme.desc: When a 17-year-old homecoming queen is found dead, wrapped in a shower curtain and dumped on the football field, the CSIs go back to school to search for suspects.
